subcommands.name: put-deployment-parameter
subcommands.description: Creates or updates a deployment parameter and is targeted by catalog and agreementId

options.name: --agreement-id
options.description: The unique identifier of the agreement

options.name: --catalog
options.description: The catalog related to the request. Fixed value: AWS Marketplace

options.name: --client-token
options.description: The idempotency token for deployment parameters. A unique identifier for the new version

options.name: --deployment-parameter
options.description: The deployment parameter targeted to the acceptor of an agreement for which to create the AWS Secret Manager resource

options.name: --expiration-date
options.description: The date when deployment parameters expire and are scheduled for deletion

options.name: --product-id
options.description: The product for which AWS Marketplace will save secrets for the buyer’s account

options.name: --tags
